{{short description|Intercollegiate basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |mode=Women's Basketball |year=2015–16 |team=Boise State Broncos |image= Boise State "B" logo.svg |image_size=150 |conference=Mountain West Conference |division= |short_conf=MWC |CoachRank= |APRank= |record=19–11 |conf_record=12–6 |head_coach=[[Gordy Presnell]] |hc_year=11th |asst_coach1=Sunny Smallwood |asst_coach2=Cody Butler |asst_coach3=Heather Sower |stadium=[[Taco Bell Arena]] |champion= |bowl= |bowl_result= }} {{2015–16 Mountain West Conference women's basketball standings}} The '''2015–16 Boise State Broncos women's basketball team''' represented [[Boise State University]] during the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I women's basketball season]]. The Broncos, led by 11th-year head coach [[Gordy Presnell]], played their home games at [[Taco Bell Arena]] and were a member of the [[Mountain West Conference]]. They finished the season 19–11, 12–6 in Mountain West play to finish in third place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2016 Mountain West Conference women's basketball tournament|Mountain West women's tournament]] to UNLV.
